plugins.name: WorkBuddy (CodeBuddy)
plugins.description: Wraps Tencent CodeBuddy (copilot.tencent.com) and WorkBuddy Global (www.workbuddy.ai) as a CLIProxyAPI provider. Supports QR/OAuth login, panel-paste or uploaded API-key credentials, CN and Global realm auto-routing, dynamic model discovery with CLI-allowlist filtering, Claude Code system-template sanitization (6 rules), tool-call pairing cleanup, hy3 max thinking, and true async streaming via host.stream.emit. Includes a protected WorkBuddy management page with account overview, OAuth plan/credit balances, model credit multipliers, and CN/Global OAuth login.
plugins.author: aiden-git
